articles.title: Sero-catalytic and spatial modeling of dengue virus force of infection in Timor-Leste
articles.description: Dengue is a public health concern in tropical and subtropical regions. Here, the authors present findings from a national, population-representative serological survey in Timor Leste and identify substantial spatial variation in force of infection.
